name: The Landing
flavor: Loud, ordinary, and everyday. Where gossip about everywhere else actually circulates.

beats.title: An Address That Isn't There
beats.body: A crate on the pier has a delivery address stamped on it that doesn't match anywhere on the current island map. The shipping company says it's a printing error. It's been a printing error for as long as anyone remembers.

beats.title: The Quiet Pier
beats.body: Dockhands have a superstition about not whistling near the third pier from the east. Nobody working there now can say why — it's just what you do, the way you don't walk under a ladder.

beats.title: A Column for Something Else
beats.body: An old harbormaster's ledger, mostly cargo tallies, has one column labeled with a word that isn't a cargo type. It's never filled in past the first few pages.

beats.title: Directions to a Building That Isn't There
beats.body: A new arrival this week asked directions to a building by a name nobody's used in living memory — and one of the oldest dockhands, without thinking about it, pointed the right way anyway.
